name: pre-pr-qa-toolkit
description: Verified browser recordings, GitHub-review triage, UI/UX guidance, OEF MCP workflows, and safe CityCatalyst demos with CC/CA error evidence.

interface.shortDescription: Record and audit real browser flows before a PR.
interface.longDescription: Record verified browser walkthroughs with timecoded evidence and structured reports, inspect GitHub review feedback, apply data-backed UI/UX guidance, route current OEF work through the connected OEF MCP app, run critical user-centered feature audits, add an optional independent Expect pass, and record the safe CityCatalyst inventory demo with CC and Climate Advisor runtime-error evidence.
defaultPrompt: Critically audit this branch as a user before its PR.
Record a browser walkthrough and report what breaks.
Record the safe CityCatalyst inventory demo and report all available CC and Climate Advisor runtime errors.
Show and classify the open GitHub PR comments without editing code.
Use OEF MCP to find the current status of this CityCatalyst ticket.
